newsitem.title: USA: Education Alternatives sets contract rules.
newsitem.headline: Education Alternatives sets contract rules.

text.p: Education Alternatives Inc, which lost some public school management contracts last year, said it set specific requirements for future contracts.

"As we go about the task of rebuilding our revenue base, our criteria is crystal clear -- we will only accept contracts that allow us to use our own employees and curriculum, the contracts must be granted directly by a state agency with full funding over an extended period of time, and attendance is by choice," said John Golle, the company's chairman and chief executive.
